LanguageData.BOR_FuelRod.label: solarite fuel rod
LanguageData.BOR_FuelRod.description:
A sunsteel container housing a remarkable - and frightening - amount of energy which can only be exploited safely in the confines of a Solarite Reactor.
Normally you would be capable of asking what happens when one of these Fuel Rods goes critical, but unfortunately craters the size of a lake cannot answer your queries.
